title: The figure 13.8 billion years is not copied here
summary: A common age of the universe was in the v1 article. It was not in the Planck abstract we read.
body: The v1 Big Bang article said the universe expanded from a hot dense state about 13.8 billion years ago, and it gave light-element percentages and a minute-by-minute timeline. The Planck 2018 abstract we read states consistency with flat ΛCDM and does not include the age numeral. Until a table is opened and the number is copied from it, the 13.8 billion year figure and the timeline numerals stay unsourced. Do not invent them.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
